description:
Turn recordings, lectures, documents, and voice notes into structured, customizable notes. Choose a format—from meeting and sales-call notes to study guides, project updates, interview summaries, and more—then review the transcript and prompt before generating notes you can save, copy, or share.

- Upload MP3, MP4, WEBM, M4A, PDF, or TXT files, or record a voice note directly.
- Select from tailored templates for meetings, lectures, sales calls, research, strategy, support, and more.
- Customize your note generation prompt before creating notes.
- Auto-Save generated notes and transcripts to your private file library
- 1-click share your notes to a dedicated public link

defaultPrompt: Make meeting notes from my video recording
Make summary notes from my PDF
make sales call notes from my audio recording
